item.title: OpenAI Pulls the Plug on Its Own Training Run
item.description: OpenAI pauses training of its most capable models. Plus: the Trump–Xi summit ends with a short trade truce, Apple loses a record $5.7B patent case, Spain's housing protests, and Olivia Rodrigo's tour opener.
